title: Temporary trial cap, heat limit and host-wide strict cap that revert on their own
description: master config trialCap=2 launchHotCelsius=80 hostHeavyJobs=1 until=TIME: master status shows each limit with its expiry, looser values are refused, merge trials stop at 2 and halve below an 80C average, two installs' trials, gate, selected tests and worker checks run one at a time without stopping running jobs, and every limit reverts to its default at expiry.

steps.name: temporary limits apply, show on master status with their expiry, and revert
